summary: Rigorous analysis has officially confirmed the performance of NASA's Artemis II heat shield following splashdown evaluations, advancing preparations for crewed lunar missions. In civil and international space developments, NASA named Stephen Cash as the director of Marshall Space Flight Center and announced it will participate in Japan's planned Martian Moons eXploration mission to study Phobos and Deimos, while the UK Space Agency contracted ClearSpace for the nation's first orbital debris removal mission. In commercial spaceflight, SpaceX launched a classified payload for the U.S. Space Force, and Rocket Lab postponed the inaugural launch of its next-generation Neutron rocket to 2027. Defense initiatives saw the U.S. Army build up a dedicated Space Operations Branch, the Air Force Air Combat Command evaluate commercial counter-drone services for base defense, and U.S. Space Forces-Northern complete a change of command at Peterson Space Force Base. On the scientific front, researchers established the first comprehensive Mars soil classification framework to guide future farming and exploration, while laboratory experiments demonstrated that plants shift gene activity within minutes of entering microgravity. Skywatchers should look up this week to observe the peak of the annual Orionid meteor shower.
